description: Ilots de chaleur : Circuit de mesures mobiles - Bayonne - Juillet 2020 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Bayonne. Cycling tour carried out as part of a study on urban heat and freshness islands (ICU - IFU) on July 29, 2020 with temperature and humidity sensors. Coverage: Ville de Bayonne. The portal shows the English title as "Heat islands: Mobile measurement circuit - Bayonne - July 2020" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Bayonne. Its keywords include canicule, humidite, ilots-de-fraicheur, temperature, ilots-de-chaleur, donnees-ouvertes. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GEOJSON, ZIP. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
